source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Ethanol" (ChemSep index 1102, CAS 64-17-5). Molecular weight, normal boiling point, Tc, Pc and acentric factor as given; standard liquid density: eq. 105 saturated liquid at 288.7056 K (60 F), as the bundled light ends; ideal-gas Cp eq. 16 (A=44530, B=-660.89, C=12.153, D=0.000019532, E=-1.5636e-8; data 150..1500 K) fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 159.05..900 K (31 points), largest deviation -0.188 % at 159.1 K, 0.097 % over 298.15..900 K; viscosity tables and freezing data in their entries. Imported by tools/compound-import.

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.

thermochemistry.source: Ideal-gas heat of formation at 298.15 K and formula C2H6O (molar mass 46.069 g/mol) of ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Ethanol" (ChemSep index 1102, CAS 64-17-5). Heats of reaction follow by Hess's law. Data only.

flammability.source: NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards, Ethyl alcohol (npgd0262, https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/npg/npgd0262.html, read 2026-11-12): LEL and UEL in air. CDC material, in the public domain. Constant with temperature (owner decision E23).

combustion.source: Hess's law on this record's thermochemistry (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1): the formula burnt to CO2, H2O (gas), SO2 and N2 on the ideal-gas heats of formation at 298.15 K of icheme:chemsep_carbon_dioxide (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1), icheme:water (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1) and icheme:chemsep_sulfur_dioxide (chemsep-8.3-hf-r1). Computed by tools/heating-values/heating-values.mjs. Read by a fired heater's burners.

liquid.source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Ethanol" (ChemSep index 1102, CAS 64-17-5): liquid viscosity eq. 101 (A=8.061, B=774.76, C=-3.0701, D=-4.3408e-9, E=2; data 200..473 K), sampled over max(data start, triple point) to 0.95 Tc into a log table by recursive bisection, log interpolation within 0.05 % at quarter and mid points. homomorph.source: The hydrocarbon homomorph of ethanol: its OH read as CH3 (CH3-CH2-OH as CH3-CH2-CH3). A gas without modified UNIFAC groups takes the E-PPR78 k_ij(T) it has with propane, on propane's own Tc, Pc and acentric factor (tools/aqueous-solvents/gas-in-organics.mjs: N2, CH4, CO2 in ethanol at 25 C within 0.85 to 0.93 of the measured solubility).
